subject.title: [UX/Bug] Model selection array order is strictly bound to checkbox ticking sequence, causing unintended primary/fallback assignment

question: Should this report be transferred to OpenClaw as a distinct runtime bug or retained here until its root cause is compared with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80521?
rationale: ClawHub has no implementation surface for the fix, while the existing OpenClaw tracker overlaps in model-ordering UX but does not prove the same failure.

options.title: Transfer distinct bug
options.body: Transfer the report to OpenClaw and cross-link the broader UI request while preserving the exact CLI reverse-selection and synchronization reproduction.

options.title: Retain linked tracker
options.body: Keep the report open in ClawHub until an OpenClaw owner confirms whether both reports share a root cause.

recommendation.title: Transfer distinct bug
recommendation.body: Transfer the report to OpenClaw and cross-link the broader UI request while preserving the exact CLI reverse-selection and synchronization reproduction.

likelyOwner.reason: Local history makes him the strongest ClawHub-side candidate to route the report to the appropriate OpenClaw owners.
